resources.name: SIESTA (or equivalent open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source pseudopotential DFT code. Equivalent codes such as Quantum ESPRESSO or GPAW may also be used.

resources.notes: DFT engine for SCF calculations, band structure interpolation, and DOS.

resources.name: Pseudopotential files for Li, Na, K, C, O

access.notes: Suitable pseudopotentials from standard databases (PseudoDojo, SIESTA database, GBRV set). Must correspond to the chosen exchange-correlation functional (LDA or GGA).

resources.notes: Norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials for all elements.
